string.text: The Ляйтдорфы are a long line of nobles within Аверлянд, where currently Marius Ляйтдорф is the Граф-Электар of Аверлянд. While this may show ultimate power within the region, the Ляйтдорфы face opposition with the Альптраўмы, who still try their hardest to vy for power in Аверлянд.

The Альптраўмы are a powerful family that had control over Аверлянд until the Ляйтдорфы created a coup and took that position. Since then the Альптраўмы have been trying to regain power over Аверлянд, believing that the Ляйтдорфы are bastardizing the economy and government.

The amount of politics between the Ляйтдорфы and the Альптраўмы is unbelievable, unlike other, more civilized nations, quick and simple war is not enough for Аверлянд, and instead petty politics take heed. That's when the Аверлянд Treatise is born, while the other lords get swayed to and fro between the Альптраўмы and Ляйтдорфы, the lords in the treatise all band together and keep eachother secure in their own way.

The Рыцары Палаючага Сонца are a small elite order of Templars devoted to the study and mastery of the science and art of warfare. These fervent followers of Myrmidia value ability and accomplishment over all other factors, including noble birth. It is because of this that the order has grown in prosperity attracting the finest military minds to its banner. A Knight of the Blazing Suns primary goal is to obtain perfection in the art of War, as such they travel the old world individually seeking battle both large and small. A warband with a Knight of the Blazing sun at its head is a potent force capable of dealing with opponents with a level of cunning that ensures victory before the battle is even joined.

They say history is made by great men and women. That is certainly true for the Vampires, but none have written that history so boldly or so thick with blood as the Von Карштайны. They are the aristocracy of the night, creatures of enormous passion and unbridled ambition, and their most trivial desires shape the destinies of entire nations. They are the greatest of all the accursed bloodlines, their vile breed spawned from the ancient terror, Count Vlad von Карштайн. For centuries, they have waged their war on the living, Vlad’s seed forever tainting the land and soddening the earth with blood. Near four hundred years ago, the last great count of Сыльванія, Mannfred von Карштайн, was slain at the battle of Хэль Фэн. Now, he has returned, to reclaim what was rightly once his.

Even before the coming of Vlad von Карштайн and his bloodthirsty children, Сыльванія was a cursed land, loathed by the Empire as a haven for Necromancers and Sorcerers. Many of these dark practitioners were those who ruled the unquiet graves, lords and nobles that studied the forbidden arts for power and longevity. In the centuries since the von Карштайны came to power, the mortal nobility and the vampiric aristocracy have formed a symbiotic relationship, a mutual assurance that Сыльванія will forever remain in the hands of those who wield the power of Nagash. Though Vampire Counts have risen and fallen, the nobility have remained, powerful Necromancers who forever seek the wisdom of Nagash.

During the Third Vampire War, it is said that Mannfred von Карштайн came upon a lonely tower in the mountains and petitioned his distant blood-cousins, the Крывавыя Драконы of Abhorash, for their aid in his bid to conquer the Empire of Sigmar. Whatever the price he promised, the Крывавыя Драконы marched alongside the Prince of Сыльванія, fell warriors of unmatched martial prowess and oathed by honour to the von Карштайн cause. Though the war ended and Mannfred was slain, some of the Крывавыя Драконы remained, taking their due right of Sylvanian soil for their service. As the only other Vampiric bloodline of note in Сыльванія, the Крывавыя Драконы have carved a dark reputation, as warriors without equal and sworn only to those they deem worthy. When Mannfred returned once more, he bound the Крывавыя Драконы to their oaths once more, and again the Крывавыя Драконы rode to war.

At the end of the third Vampire Wars and the cleansing of Gottlieb the Stern, the land of Сыльванія was legally subsumed into the Grand County of Stirland. Even so, the land was forever a cursed and unloved place, rarely ventured into by the nobility that knew better. Instead, it became a place of exile, inheritance for prodigal sons and washed up nobility that had no place in the courts of Stirland. While many of these outcasts took to their new responsibilities with stoic determination, others sought greater opportunity. These are such traitors, kinslayers and deceivers who betrayed their homeland and family for damnation. They are the youngest of the vampires, newborn babes with the strength and appetite of daemons. Their only desire is to revel in their new unlife, to exult in their dark nature and live as gods among cowering men.

Крывавая Крэпасьць was once the home of a valiant order of Knights known as the Ордэн Крывавага Дракона, or the Ordo Draconis. One fateful night, a Vampire known as Walach Harkon challenged every Knight to single combat, eventually turning all who he deemed worthy into Vampires. The death of the Ordo Draconis was followed by their rebirth in blood; ever since then these terrifying warriors have been known as the Крывавыя Драконы. The Imperials suffered under their attacks and depravations for sixty years, before they amassed a force to raze the Keep. That was almost six centuries ago, for all that time the ruins of the keep lay undisturbed. Now, the keep rises again, built by the silent undead, and the men of the Empire will again know fear.

Dedicated to the study of the Grimoire Necronium Zacharias and his followers empower themselves in his tower to destory the empire and its allies. Zacharias has collected followers from all over the empire to strenghten his army. After slaying his old dark master Мельхіёр the ancient he became the most powerfull necrarch in existing.

The Шалёны Дом Лембрук was a Physician's Guild, not to grant succour to the insane, as the priestesses of Shallya do in their hospices, but as a home for the study of the deranged in a secluded location where only the beasts and trees would be able to hear the screams. Lembrooke was run by doctors Feder and Teer, who were at the forefront of their field, using such forward-thinking techniques as trepanation to let the troublesome Daemons out through holes in the skull, thyroid removal, heated brands, and mild poisoning. After Dentomaz killed the staff he claimed the Lunatics as his servants.

When first assuming power, Alberich Гаўпт-Андэрсан focused all of his efforts in having a tight knit alliance between all of the other lords to ensure economic stability and the safety around Wurtzbach and in the west of Stirland. This alliance is difficult to maintain even at the best of times due to Alberich’s young age and the general insecurity of his house. With an increasingly fraught eastern border with Сыльванія, this alliance is growing more and more unsteady.

While the lords of western Шцірлянд are content to bicker over trade with the Мут and Аверлянд, the lords of the East are all too aware of the trouble brewing on their border. The dead are restless, crops are failing and more and more ill tidings come out of the county of Сыльванія. Already it has been many months since they were last able to contact the lords of that land, and now the roads east are far too dangerous to try now. The omens do not lie however; the eastern lords have watched the once fertile land darken from the corruption that their advising magisters say is coming from further east. As a result, they have abandoned any ideas of peace, and have prepared for war or worse to come. Travelling through this region of Шцірлянд will render the same impression; these are the border folk of the empire: they are the first line of defence against evil and are willing to meet it head on.

Паўднёвы Шцірлянд is home to the Skaranorak pilgrimage which spans from Schrambleben to the southern mountains. While this brings much popularity and allows for the church of sigmar to help with the effort to stave off the corruption of the undead, Паўднёвы Шцірлянд does come with its problems, such as issues regarding outsiders and pilgrims stealing from reputable stores, halfling border disputes, and attempts to ambush pilgrims in the Zhufbar road which is used for the Skaranorak Pilgrimage.

The фон Лібвіц are a relatively new family, having come within the last century to dominate Нульн and the immediate surrounding area. Emmanuelle and Leos’s father was the last elector count; thanks to a sudden death and Leos being far too young to take the throne, Emmanuelle became the Elector-Countess of Вісэнлянд.

The Топенгаймары are a revered family that have dominated southern Вісэнлянд and northern Солянд for at least five centuries. The relationship with their vessels and subjects is an interesting one; for the Топенгаймары are often viewed as being neither fully Wissenlander or Sollander. This relationship has enabled them to act as kingmaker in Вісэнлянд, giving whoever has their favour a great advantage over their rivals within and without the province.

Солянд was once full of hope and light. Now the people carry a great shame upon their soul, a weariness that seems to burden them with the pain of their ancestors. Солянд has never recovered since its destruction by Greenskins many centuries ago, accordingly the once sanguine spirit of the people here has turned melancholic. The lords in this region are no different. They do what they can to ease the burden of their people, while always preparing for whatever may be coming with the next dawn.

The Chosen of Taal is the ruling clan of Талабэклянд. This clan was formed through the union of two families; Countess Elise’s, the ruler of Талабхайм, and Grand Duke Helmut Feuerbach, the ruler of the Grand Duchy of Талабэклянд. The families knew it would be foolish for Taal’s children to feud over control of his holy land and so the political alliance was cemented with marriage. The dynasty is now in its second generation of rulers; Gustav XI Krieglitz-Untern having established this alliance by the marriage of his daughter Elise to Helmut. As Граф-Электар, Helmut operates as the official ruler of both the clan and Талабэклянд, known for his iron fist and foul temper. Countess Elise is rumoured however to have far more to do with the true political decision making within the province and is known for her influence within both the Cults of Taal and Verena.
An unassuming clan with a warlike background. They keep to themselves and solve problems amongst themselves their own way. They don’t take kindly to strangers or refugees.

The Рындэнгаўт (Barkskin) Clan centres its power along the River Stir and in the wild places of Southern Талабэклянд. They are devout worshippers of Taal and many clan members will often seek to keep the Great Forest clear of befoulment alongside the wardens of the Cult of Taal such as the Longshanks and Druids. Nobles outside of von Schirach often complain about their aloofness and horrible manners; many times it can be difficult to get into contact with certain members due to the long pilgrimages through the holy places of Taal that they often embark on.

The House фон Хольшвіг-Шліштайн is the ruling dynasty of the Empire of Man. Its head is Emperor Karl-Franz von Holswig-Schliestein. The house was founded by Emperor Wilhelm the Wise, who ruled the Empire from 2429 to 2434 IC. Today, the von Holswig-Schliesteiners remain deeply entrenched in Альтдорф, where their heraldry is so common it is often mistaken for the city’s own.

The фон Валенштайны are a noble family of the empire, more concerned with their pleasure and enjoyment than with serving as governors of their territories. Ferdinand, the current Graf, prefers to spend his time in his luxurious palaces in Альтдорф and Нульн. While his uncle Adelbert, now older, feels rejuvenated by going on hunting parties for orcs and goblins in the nearby forests. Both ignore the politics of their territory, delegating these tasks to local burgomeisters.

Margrave Reinhardt фон Макензэн is the ruler of Хэльмгарт, and believes that the Empire needs a Lord Protector of the Gray Mountains to oversee the defense of the border and the passes through the Gray Mountains. Naturally, he believes that he is the perfect man for the position and seeks to sabotage any pretensions of other nobles. He will focus his attention on whoever he determines is 'in the lead'.

The фон Сапонатхайм family is in charge of governing Бёгенхафэн. Many nobles look down on this family, as the фон Сапонатхайм nobility is 'new' and does not have the prestige or renown of older houses. But despite this, their coffers are fuller, since they manage the production and import of one of the best wines in the empire.

The Тодбрынгеры hail from the Teutogen kings of old who ruled what is now the Northern Empire. There has been a lasting rivalry between the north and south that lasts to this day, hostilities flare up at times diplomatically and at times through force of arms. The Тодбрынгеры support the need for an Emperor, and Boris sees himself as the perfect candidate for the throne, instead of some puppet of the Sigmarite church. Yet the many threats of the Драквальд, and from the Sea of Claws, keeps the Граф-Электар too busy to focus on much else.

The proximity to the Райклянд does not change the fact that the Більдхофэны are far more aligned with the northern lands of the empire. The Більдхофэны have a long lasting bloodline, traced back to none other than Magnus фон Більдхофэн, the Pious. However, despite such a glorious lineage there is not much influence left amongst the Більдхофэны and the noble family is situated in a peaceful but insignificant role.

The Драквальдзкая Варта was born from the need to fight back the growing beastmen threat, to defend the many caravans and villages throughout the dark forest. The Armies of this Organisation are from former, eradicated or dispersed baronies, Huntsmen and Mercenaries. However, devoted followers of Ulric assist in their battles. In the Name of Ulric and the Тодбрынгеры, they clean the Драквальд from the taint of Chaos it suffers from.

Wolfram Хертвіг at age fifteen became the Chancellor of Остэрмарк, in the year 2485, to fill the void left by an invading Orc Waaagh! The young Wolfram refused to allow the much more experienced Grandmaster of the Knights of the Everlasting Light to lead the forces of Остэрмарк against the Orcs at the Battle of Black Road. As a result, the inexperienced youth led his men to a terrible defeat; infamously known as Hertwig’s Folly. Today, Wolfram and the Хертвіг family have mostly rebuilt their reputation, as many Ostermarkers remember their leadership in the aftermath of Hertwig’s Folly and the success the province has had ever since. Yet to outsiders, the Хертвігі are still remembered for their young count and a defeat snatched out of the jaws of victory.

Clan Швайсбраў isn’t descended from noble lineage, however, dedication and determination are proven substitutes. Stefan Husserl began his life as a commoner, the son of a local village smith, his village came under attack from a roaming group of beastmen, seeking easy prey, the villagers were quickly cut down as they fled, including his father, whom he looked in the eyes just before he was impaled by an Ungor. Taking up a blade he had forged, he walked past the fleeing townsfolk, and something changed within him. He struck back at the beasts, slaying the ungors and gors that tried to attack him. Some of the fleeing locals turned and recalled seeing him wrapped in a shining light amidst a sea of darkness and blood, wading through unscathed. The villagers, reinvigorated, ran back towards their home with pitchforks and mallets and took the fight to the beastmen. The beasts broke as Stefan himself held the bloodied head of the Beastlord that led the attack on his village. From that day the common folk realised they needed no fancy armour or weapons, only determination and courage to beat back the enemies of man. The surrounding villages came to recognise Stefan as their leader, even the elector count himself acknowledged his right to rule over the commoners in the southwest. Stefan now rules over a court he rarely visits, for there are enemies to be slain and he is now hunting for them.

The Зібентод clan has been around for as long as the vampire wars, always on the lookout for the undead and Sigmar knows what else. The fact that there is still an Остэрмарк to protect speaks volumes about the efficiency of their efforts. Yet it seems their work is never done, it doesn’t matter. For as long as the flag of Остэрмарк flies high over the Eerie Downs and the siebentod clan has an arse in its seat the undead will be put to rest.

The Людэнхофы are the rightful owner of Хохлянд. Aldebrand enjoys the highest reputation among his people. The land faces several dangers, like Beastmen of the Драквальд forest or the uprising Chaos forces beyond the Middle mountains. Ludendorf, and his sons try to stand their ground against all threats , protecting Хохлянд, and the Empire itself with all their strength.

Ruled by one of the twins of the recently deceased Victor фон Хальбервальд, Ludwig war born just 2-minutes earlier and therefore was seen as the rightful ruler of the Halberwalds. The family wealth is based on the many hunting grounds in the Драквальд forest and the mines in the middle mountains, selling several resources and pelts south of the empire. The brothers are as distinct as one could imagine. Ludwig, apart from being a gun-lover, was also a good businessman, being able to maximise the exploitation of the mines and hunting grounds. Bernd on the other hand cares for the people, he devoted his life to Taal and often only takes what nature provides for him. While the brothers are distinctly different and can often be seen arguing, the love of their family and land comes before all else and they would die side by side to protect it.

The Хохэнштайны built their wealth upon the woodwork in the province. They own several lumber mills along the River Drakwasser and Flaschgang. Despite the myriad beastmen threats they never let production stop. Their timber is mostly used for furniture but more importantly is used to craft the famous Хохлянд long-rifles. While there is nothing particularly unique about their wood, it is especially famous among gunsmiths. Their business is one of the very few very profitable ones throughout Хохлянд.

The Гаўсэры are an ancient family of Нордлянд whose lineage can be traced back to a Juton chieftain, Gansser the Patient, who claims he was the first of the tribe to recognize the divinity of Sigmar. Descendant of Sovereign Countess Eleonore Гаўсэр, one of the city's most beloved historical figures. Eleonore oversaw the construction of Manann Cathedral, founded the Knights of the North Star, defended Зальцэнмунд from the Earl of the Wildlands in 1700 IC, and signed an alliance pact with the Eonir. Over the past few centuries, the Гаўсэры remained powerful, but were sidelined by the Nikse who have dominated since 2209 IC. Мідэнхайм has kept Нордлянд and its capital under control, while the Гаўсэры were furious. Although the Nikse tried to gain Theoderic's support by appointing him Northern Marshal of the State Army, the Гаўсэры wanted to right centuries of perceived wrongs. Currently, Theoderic has aspirations within the empire, such as building the second fleet of the Imperial Navy, reclaiming the coastal land of Остлянд that was historically part of Нордлянд; and another series of ideas which are more crazy than the previous one.

The Зальцблут clan is relatively new, established to distinguish those old souls who are part of the new Imperial fleet and most of the prominent figures are either renowned sailors or esteemed warriors. Ever since the secession of Marienburg from the Empire, the wind has been taken out of the sails from the Imperial navy. The navy has been struggling ever since, while the first Imperial fleet has enough warships, there is too much diversity on the decks, mixing arrogant nobles with weathered sailors, but the sailors are not very noble, and the nobles are certainly not sailors. Нордлянд, being a maritime province, has a long history of naval combat and dealing with coastal raids upon their lands. Many a Нордлянд sailor claim they are worth their weight in salt ten times over compared to those snobby fops in Райклянд.

The Мэргот clan has had many identities over the years, but was always meant to contain some aspect of Manann. The clan mostly deals with religious affairs and ensures the proper rites are taken when a ship first sets sail and makes sure it doesn’t sink on its maiden voyage. The clan usually contains several figureheads who are dedicated to Manann, but also contain a representative of the church of Sigmar to ensure Manann doesn’t overshadow the warrior god. This doesn’t mean that every member is a devout priest, usually they are an admiral or an old seadog with experience in maritime matters.

The current ruling house of Остлянд, though an ancient and noble clan known for its longstanding loyalty to the Emperors, only recently ascended to rulership of the Grand Principality. Valmir фон Раўкаў was granted the province to restore stability following accusations of heresy and treason against previous lords of Остлянд.

Dominating a sizeable portion of Western Остлянд are the Middle Mountains, Lords of key fortresses, garrisons and towns are entrusted to guard vital passes and trails. Those who stand warden are often under the supervision of Marshal von Strudt.

While Grand Prince Valmir bears the formal title of Margrave of the Паўночная Марка, it is the dutiful lords of Остлянд's northern and eastern frontiers who maintain a constant vigil against the incursions of Norscan reavers and the hosts of Chaos.

The towns and trading posts of North Талабэк (the southernmost region of Остлянд), especially those on the Талабэк River, are generally cosmopolitan by Остлянд standards. They profit not only from trade with Imperial provinces to the south and west, but also their proximity to the confluence of the Rivers Urskoy and Талабэк - and therefore to Kislevite Zavastra and Kislev itself.

Брыднаўты of Масянжавая Крэпасьць are not a single tribe or clan, but a festering congregation of several Chaos warbands united beneath a single banner. Each pursues its own vile agenda, yet all are bound together by their shared worship of the Urfather. The Масянжавая Крэпасьць gives them a formidable defensive position from which they launch raids into the Empire. How their numbers continue to swell remains a mystery. Imperial patrols report no sightings of warbands travelling to the Keep, yet the Blightkings grow ever stronger and more numerous. There are rumours of a hidden portal buried deep beneath the Масянжавая Крэпасьць, through which reinforcements are said to arrive from the frozen North.

Though he does not ride at the head of an army, nor sit on a royal throne, Jaan ван дэ Кюперс - reputedly the world’s richest man, and certainly Marienburg’s most influential - is more powerful than many Old Worlder kings. He manipulates the Directorate, the Вэйстлянд’s oligarchic council, through a carefully cultivated and bullied bloc of allies and puppets - not limited to the Штадтхолдар, several other Directors of the Ten, the Rector of Baron Henryk's College, and the High Priests of at least two religious cults. Nevertheless, absolute as van de Kuypers’ stranglehold on Marienburger politics may seem, various rival factions should not be underestimated.

The Культ Манана, god of the sea, is centred in Marienburg and is the Вэйстлянд’s richest and most powerful religion. Matriarch Camille Dauphina, the Cult’s nominal head in the northern Old World, is a middle-aged woman of pragmatism and wry wit. She has connections with most of the merchant families in Marienburg and uses the navigators, pilots, and priests of the Order of the Albatross to keep tabs on mercantile affairs internationally. This, and her lavish commissioning of new works for the high temple, have led some in the Manannite clergy to feel she is turning the Cult into a merchant guild - something the rival Cult of Haendryk is all too eager to amplify.

Though small, House дэн Эўэ is exceedingly wealthy from trade in Nipponese and Cathayan exotics and precious gems and metals. Until recently part of the clique dominated by Jaan ван дэ Кюперс, дэн Эўэ patriarch Karl has come to feel that Jaan's wealth and influence threaten the careful balance of control in Marienburg. Cautiously and gradually, Director дэн Эўэ has been building ties to the Foogers, the van den Nijmenks, the de Roelefs, the van Onderzoekers, and the Cult of Shallya - a potential faction of not-insignificant power.

Heir to House ван Хаген, Crispijn is widely known as a carouser, a risk-taker, a show-off, and a wastrel. This is only half the truth, for he shares his father’s knack for politics and force of personality, if not his prudence or discipline. Crispijn is also a bold and instinctive, if unproven, commander. Eager to prove himself beyond his father’s long shadow, the ‘Strutting Cock of Goudberg’ has recently taken to assuming personal command of troops within House van Haagen’s extensive private retinues.

The Dukedom of Курон is a founding dukedom of Bretonnia that lies upon the northern shores of that realm and is the current seat of power of the king's Royal Court, located in the dukedom, and the kingdom's capital, Castle Couronne.

Шэвалье д'Анёр are the friends and supporters of the king. Those who have proven to be a great asset to the crown get the honour title of Chevalier D'Honneur. Members of this group have completed important quests and battles for king Louen and have proven to be loyal knights of the realm and king.

The knights of Ле Ардзі дэ Монмірай are led by Roland the Marechal. They are tasked with protecting the border between Курон and Marienburg in the east of Couronne. The border is a grey area with no factual borders. Roland the Marechal tries to take more land with every opportunity he has creating conflict between Brettonia and Marienbug.

Л'Ангіль, formally the Dukedom of Л'Ангіль, is a dukedom of Bretonnia that lies at the northern shores of that kingdom. Known far and wide for having some of the busiest ports in all of Bretonnia, Л'Ангіль is a rich dukedom that relies heavily on sea-trade for their fortunes. As such, there is a large number of merchants and middle-class commoners amongst the peasant population of the capital.

Ліёнэс, formally the Dukedom of Ліёнэс, is one of the founding dukedoms of Bretonnia that lies upon the north-western shores of that kingdom. One of the larger dukedoms, the lands of Ліёнэс are infamously known for their rivalry not with the other Bretonnian dukedoms, but amongst their own nobility, even in comparison to the feudal conflicts which plague the other realms of Bretonnia. People blame the unusual geography of the dukedom for the prevalence of the internecine strife, particularly the profusion of excellent sites for fortifications, which deters rival dukedoms from waging war or pursuing feuds with the lords of Lyonesse.

Артуа, formally the Dukedom of Артуа, is a founding dukedom of Bretonnia that lies at the heart of the northern lands of that kingdom. Unlike the lush meadows of Bretonnia's other dukedoms, Артуа is famous for being the only dukedom that is covered entirely by forested wilderness, known by the Bretonnians as the Forest of Arden. Due to this, the dukedom is in a constant state of warfare against tribes of Beastmen that have made the forest their new dark home.

Жызарэ, formally the Dukedom of Жызарэ, is a founding dukedom of Bretonnia that lies within the treacherous slopes of the Pale Sisters and upon the low woodlands of the Forest of Arden. Unlike in other parts of Bretonnia, where much of the land is either one type of landscape and of one type of people, the diversity in geography of this Dukedom has also created a diversity in cultures and customs. Those living within the arable plains to the south contain the typical farmers and peasants that is universal within all the realms. To the east, the lands are filled with harsh woodlands, where a different people live life as expert trappers and wild woodsmen. Finally, to the north, those people that can eke out a living within the Pale Sisters are seasoned mountaineers who can brave harsh conditions. The Dukedom also contains the Жызарэ Gap, one of only three locations within the entire Grey Mountains that allow passage between Bretonnia and the Empire.

Upon the southern reaches of the Grey Mountains lies the Bretonnian Dwelling of Parravon. Парравон controls one of the 3 routes leading directly into the Empire from the Grey Mountains, that being Grey Lady Pass. Due to the duchy being situated both at the base and in the Grey Mountains, the Parravoners have an affinity with the resident Pegasi that reside within the mountain tops. Indeed, Duke Cassyon de ‘Parravon has befriended the lord of all Pegasi, Glorfinal.

North of the southern province of Парравон, and in the east of Bretonnia, the castles of Манфор reside. Like Парравон, the duchy of Манфор resides within the Grey mountains and below. Within Манфор lies one of the three passes into the Empire from the Grey Mountains, that being Axe Bite Pass. Being situated into the Mountainous regions, the Манфор peoples are hardy mountaineers themselves and due to constant raids, the Montfortians have developed a prejudice to any outsiders that are not Human, such as dwarfs, halflings, or elves.

At the very heart of Bretonnia lies the Duchy of Bastonne. Indeed located at the heart, but also many believe that Бастон is the Heart of Bretonnia. Founded by Gilles le Breton, the Cathedral for the Cult of the Lady is housed within Castle Bastonne’s walls. Indeed, just in the Forest of Chalons is said to be where Gilles and the Companions first met The Lady. Because Бастон is the Heart of Bretonnia, the people of Бастон are the most haughty and cocky of the Bretonnians. Бастон holds in its service most of Bretonnia’s grail Knights, and rightly claims to be the most important of all Duchies.

The Гарамон family name has long been respected inside of Bastonne. However it was not until the death of his father that the Гарамон name rose to fame across the whole Kingdom of Bretonnia. Calard slew a Beastmen warlord, avenging his father who had died moments before and saving Бардэло from this grave threat.

The company kept by Duke Alberic is an interesting one. None but the most stalwart and talented knights are long permitted to fight alongside the Bordelen duke. As such, the men who are entrusted with the security of the realm are some of the most capable fighters, and outlandish nobles, in the whole of Bretonnia.

There are those who say that anyone born in Брыён has the soul of a poet. Here, poetry is as important as martial skill. The castles and fortresses of the region also seem to contribute to this goal. Many have been built in practically indefensible places just to be in harmony with the landscape, even going so far as to build towers with large windows and seats to listen to the troubadours, instead of serving for defense.

The people of Кенэль are fanatically dedicated to the complete destruction of Greenskins, particularly those who come down out of Massif Orcal to pillage their lands. Their questing knights are particularly renowned amongst the dwarfs, as many of them use their grail quest to venture into the mountains and badlands of the Old World. Despite this, the greenskins remain an ever present threat to the Dukedom, despite centuries of attempted extermination and colonisation of Massif Orcal. It remains a mystery as to why Кенэль suffers so much from the greenskins compared to their neighbours; some suspect that the descendents of Cuileux may have been cursed.

As two sides of the same Guilder there are no other roles that embody the power, faith and traditions of Bretonnia more than the Grail Knight and Damsel. To face either of these in battle is to feel the divine wrath of the Lady of the Lake herself. It is so much more terrifying than to face a pair of them on the same battlefield. For reasons unarticulated, Ser Leon and Lady Mathilde are rarely if ever parted from each other. In war this makes for a nearly unstoppable union, while in peace it raises a number of questions most Bretonnians are uncomfortable trying to answer.

Аквітань is a peaceful region whose landscape is almost entirely made up of valleys abounding in pasture land and vineyards; which produce the famous wine that gives its name to the duchy, and to which aphrodisiac properties are attributed. Аквітань is also the place where Gilles le Breton fought many of his battles, which is why numerous Grail Knights can be seen in these lands.

A highly martial Dukedom, Каркасон heavily focuses on militarization, and puts a heavy focus on the eradication of the Greenskin tribes in the Irrana mountains. Almost every person in Каркасон, from the lowest of peasant to the highest of noble, is a warrior. Каркасон has a strong bond to Брыён, due to the Каркасон people’s fondness of poetry and music. They often remark with regards to Брыён that “We fight so the Brionnians don’t have to”

The powerful castle Gaudaron rises above the foothills of the Vaults, watching over the Carcassonni border with both the forest of Loren and the lands of Tilea. Its lord, the Grail Knight Ser Amalric de Gaudaron is a powerful warrior, selected by the Lady herself to be the chosen warrior of Bretonnia. To aid him, the Fay Enchantress has sent the Twin Damsels Giulia and Margherita de Turín to his side, to provide him with their assistance and counsel both in the heat of battle and outside of it.

The dukedom of Музільён is a haggard and dreaded land, full of swamps and cursed bogs. An impoverished land constantly plagued by disease, which many of its inhabitants have grown accustomed to. As such, many Mousillians are considered to be mutants and freaks compared to normal Bretonnian peasants. The villages and castles are at the point of collapse, while the nights are haunted by apparitions and vile beasts. Only fools and deadmen leave their homes at night.

Aucassin's family has resided in the Шато Ан for generations, and the chanson of his family is among the longest in the whole of Bretonnia. His ancestors fought for Maldred against the king and against the Duke of Ліёнэс for Merovech before that. Though proven in battle, Aucassin's family is mostly noted as patrons of the arts and exemplars of courtly culture, and Aucassin himself is Музільён's most cultured noble. His court, held in the handsome Шато Ан, includes poets and artists to entertain the nobles who come to visit (nobles including Mallobaude himself). Aucassin is the hub of Музільён's noble culture.

The Паўросьлікі are a peaceful and friendly people, very fond of festivities and large banquets, enjoying fun and especially food. They are a people with little ambition, so they hardly care about military matters, little interested in what may happen outside their lands. Consequently, life in the Assembly is often very boring for young Паўросьлікі, and although Паўросьлікі are generally not fond of travel, some do seek adventure in the outside world.

The Heart of the Атэль Лорэн, Талсін forms the largest, most prosperous and realm with the highest population of Asrai. Not only the King’s Glade, the residence of Ariel and Orion, but also the Дуб Вякоў can be found here. In this realm the tree spirits and the Asrai form the strongest bond. Since the realm includes the very heart of the wood elves, it is their most holy refugium.

When Morghur was defeated in the high realm Анмір, his blood corrupted the forest slowly but steadily. Анмір, also known as the Witherhold. Every year the beastmen tribes grew stronger, - every year more forest spirits fell into chaos and corruption. While all other realms are aware and send their help to cleanse the corruption, the ruinous forces are grewing inevitable stronger.

Атыльвіт, also known as the Winterheart, is the coldest part of Атэль Лорэн. The harsh climate conditions made the inhabitants of this part of the forest more enduring and stronger. The harsh conditions make it almost impossible for nature spirits to fulfill this place with magic which make the defense of this region solely dependent on the protection of the elves. It is no wonder that the Eternal Guards are most numerous in the Halls of this region.

Also known as the Moonspring Glades, is known for its wonders and powerful magic. Other than in most other realms, the inhabitants still follow the traditions, norms and values of the Asur once settled over from Ulthuan. A strict bureaucracy is still maintained in the realm. Following from this, it is no wonder that the inhabitants of Аргвілон also kept the arrogance which the Asur are infamous for.

The summerstrand, as some refer to Аранок, forms a high realm of Атэль Лорэн, where winter is ever absent, nights are short and sun is shining all year. The realm is famous for their feasts, and their hospitality - even for foreigners visiting in a peaceful manner. Overall the realm feels peaceful and friendly, yet especially some mean tree spirits could use the inattentiveness that is following from wine and joy for their advantage.

Caravoc, also known as the Skymark Reaches can be found at the most south western end of Атэль Лорэн, and is because of the quite sparse tree population and many glades plagued by foreigners of the wood. The Bretones of Carcasonne build their settlements dangerously close or even inside the territory of Cavaroc. Also beastmen often try to find their entry into the woods via the glades of this High Realm. However the kin of Каварок are exceptional horse riders that know how to protect their land.

Not all Tree spirits seek harmony with the elves. For them the elves created a prison, the Сітрал also known as the Wildwood. The Borders to the Сітрал are protected with a fence of waystones and the people of the high realm. While the waystones in theory should hinder the evil tree spirits, the Asrai of Сітрал have to actively defend and maintain the waystones in order to keep the spirits from escaping.

The Highrealm of Фір Даррык, is also known as the Trickster Wood, dedicated to the god of music Revelry, Joy and Trickery, Loec. It is no mystery that in these Woods the Wardancers found a safe haven. They come here to express their fighting skills, train and fight duels. While their acrobatics impress, the daily practices are brutal, and the arena floors are stained with blood. For many, the arena fights end in death.

Night glades, Модрын, is the High Realm of Атэль Лорэн that resides in eternal darkness of the night. The forest spirits, as well as elven inhabitants are more spiteful than in other areas of Атэль Лорэн. The people of Модрын are aligned to the Cytharai, the gods usually worshiped by the Druchii. Mordryn is known for their practitioners of Dark Magic, which are nowhere as numerous anywhere else in Athel loren.

It is said that in Tirsityth, no joyful song is ever played, just the dirges of Elves who live under the shadow of death. However the inhabitants of Ashenhall as the High realm is also called, are in fact not any more fatalistic than other realms, they do however respect life's end as they respect its start. The realm is decorated with moonstones that were placed in honor of departed. Even the nature spirits respect these gestures, and grow groves around beloved wood elves. Anybody who comes to disturb the peace of the dead, will evoke the wrath of these kin.

Also known as the Forges of Starlight, Торгаван is famous for Asrai Artisans and craftsmanship. Blessed by Vaul's Anvil, the forge-temple of Торгаван is the origin of the most exquisite weaponry, upon the realm of the Asrai. The central position of Торгаван inside the forest makes it easily reachable for other realms, and with that a central exchange post with other kin bands in the forest.

The Realm of Відрыёт, is bordering the western parts of the Grey mountains. In the past, many invaders, among these men, greenskins and dwarfs were trying to pass the realm unsuccessfully. The inhabitants are masterful ambushers, their terrain is covered with several hideouts, secret outposts, and hidden pathways to execute ambushes. While the Kin of Відрыёт are severely outnumbered, they are able to survive and withstand any intruder to the realm of the wood elves.

The twins Naestra and Arahan, are as night and day, yet no day passed one have seen them separated from each other. While Naestrais usually favoring diplomacy over the sword, Arahanis seeking for the confrontation where she could. While their disputes seem heated, their differences lead to a perfect symbiosis, making them legendary protectors of Атэль Лорэн.

The Ward of Sun contains mostly ‘Toriour’, the city-born Kindred of the Eonir. Through the fallback of the Asur following the Events of the War of Beard, many Asur throughout the Empire searched for refuge in the elves' Last Bastion.

The Ward of the Rain mostly covers the marshes that are hugged by the forest of Лаўрэлорн. Its direct connection to Tor Lithanel makes it the quickest route to the Вэйстлянд and Marienburg, where the Eonir from now and then keep business and political exchange with local High Elf Enclave. The Protection of these uninviting marshes is therefore crucial for the fragile Elven province.

The Ward of the Storm protects the northern part of the Лаўрэлорн forest and possesses Laurelorns only access to the coast enabling trade with far reaching factions all over the world. While its inhabitants are protective like any of the other wardens, they are also more communicative and diplomatic towards the people they are bordering or cross their ways on the seas. It is not unlikely that a confrontation does not need to end in bloodshed, but a trade - as long the warden benefits from it.

The Ward of the Frost has a complex relation to the surrounding Нордлянд that essentially crosses and traverses the parts that once entirely counted towards the Ward of Frost. The complex division of this section of the country makes clear ownership and responsibility almost impossible, leading involuntarily to dispute and forced cooperation between humans and Eonir.

The Ангрулок Clan has ruled Карак Кадрын ever since its founding. Baragor Ungrim, Ungrim Ironfist’s five times great grandsire, suffered a terrible loss which drove him to take the Slayer Oath. What caused such a drastic decision is not recorded. The nature of Baragor's shame has been forgotten by his people as a sign of respect, and the secret is passed down from one Slayer King to the next, until one of them can make atonement. It is commonly assumed that the cause was the death of his daughter at the claws of the dragon Skaladrak while on her way to marry the son of the High King of Karaz-a-Karak. In any case, Baragor became the first Slayer King of Карак Кадрын. The burden of his shame weighs heavy upon the shoulders of his descendants, and Ungrim is no different.

The Азрылгрунд Clan was founded after a solemn pact between Dorin Silverfoot and Prince Ulther Stonehammer was made, uniting the remnants of two fallen holds, Karak Ungor and the Silver Pinnacle, under a single banner. The clan’s name honours the royal bloodlines of both founders: Stonehammer and Silverfoot. Though rare, such fusions do occur among the Dawi, especially when driven by shared loss and a common cause. Typically, such unions are in name only, as each lineage preserves its distinct identity and dreams of reclaiming its ancestral hall. Clan Азрылгрунд has carved out a small yet resolute realm within the lands of Карак Кадрын. It is ruled by Dorin Silverfoot, while Crown Prince Ulther Stonehammer wages a relentless campaign against the Greenskins and Chaos Dwarfs that infest the region. Ulther refuses the throne until Karak Ungor is taken back by Dwarf hands, a vow that burns fiercely in the hearts of his kin. Attempts to reclaim Karaz Bryn have been few and fraught with failure, for the Pale Lady, cursed vampire mistress of the Silver Pinnacle, always seems to anticipate the Dwarfs’ every move. Millennia have passed since the last great assault on Karak Ungor. Though the Dawi once managed to seize the southern valley and its gate, the citadel itself proved impenetrable. Heavy losses forced a bitter retreat. When Karak Ungor is reclaimed, its forges and artillery will be turned toward the black spires of Karaz Bryn, and hopefully reclaim it once and for all. Now, clan Азрылгрунд grows strong once more. Their axes are sharp, their hearts grim, and the drums of war echo once again in the mountain halls.

Clan Бранмаказ holds dominion from Карак Ангазхар, a sturdy hold situated east of the Black Mountains. These mountains are known for their plentiful deposits of iron, gold, and silver, though they are notably lacking in the rarer and more precious metals prized by the Dawi. However, the eastern ridges of the range are home to a modest yield of obsidian, a dark, glassy stone sharp enough to cleave steel, but brittle when mishandled. Due to its fragility, the Dwarfs of Карак Ангазхар do not fashion warhammers from obsidian, as is more common among their kind. Instead, they forge axe-heads of exceptional sharpness from the material, each requiring considerable time and craft to perfect. These weapons are not wielded lightly. Only members of the Ebonshard Brotherhood, an elite fighting unit drawn from the heart of Clan Бранмаказ, are permitted to bear such arms. To wield the black-edged axe is to have proven oneself in battle, through grit, resolve, and the spilling of no small amount of blood. Карак Ангазхар serves primarily as a trading hub, dealing in finely wrought tools and valuable crafts with the men of the Empire. Meanwhile, the fortress of Mighdal Vongalbarak, perched near the fabled Black Fire Pass, stands as the bulwark of the region. There, Dwarf sentries keep eternal vigil. From its towers, signal fires can be lit and runes of distress dispatched, east to Karaz Ankor or north along the mountain roads, should enemies stir and reinforcements be called.

Clan Азгараз has endured for as long as the stronghold from which it takes its name. In earlier centuries, the clan focused primarily on internal growth and deep delving beneath the Grey Mountains. However, since the death of King Zaladrin Strife-Axe, Clan Азгараз has taken a more vengeful course. Under the rule of King Thuringar Orc-Hewer, the clan has returned to the old ways, settling grudges with stone and steel, and driving the wretched Goblin and Orc tribes from the mountain halls they dare to defile. In addition to war, the clan now seeks expansion, for the gold and silver veins that once sustained them grow thin. New seams must be found, and new mines hewn, if the hold is to prosper once more.

Many of the other ruling clans regard Clan Панцыр-Сталь as one of the lesser lineages, unworthy of a seat upon the King’s council, and believe it ought to be absorbed into Карак Ізор. In defiance of such scorn, King Hergar fights tooth and nail for his clan’s place in the world, forging numerous alliances throughout the southern realms. Though the Dwarfs of Карак Экcьфілаз seldom involve themselves directly in the petty squabbles of Men, they are known to supply weapons to all sides and should the need arise, they will march to war alongside their allies against mutual foes, be it raiding Greenskins from the east or Skaven from the west. The southern princelings have each sworn oaths of loyalty to King Hergar, vowing to stand by him should the eastern Dwarfs ever attempt to enforce their claim to subsume Карак Экcьфілаз into Карак Ізор.

Clan Грундбак (Khazalid for Hammerfist) has led Карак Гантук through hardship and strife since the first Dwarfs set foot in the region. The clan earned its name in ages past, when the ancestors of King Skag Hammerfist laboured with relentless determination to carve their hold into the unforgiving stone. Legend tells, perhaps with a touch of Dwarfen exaggeration, that some toiled with their bare fists, hammering the rock into submission to forge the foundations of Карак Гантук itself.

Clan Дражкарак has stood since the founding of Карак Хірн, and has ruled the hold ever since. Fierce traditionalists, the clan has upheld the ancient customs of the Dwarfs with unwavering resolve, each successive generation more staunchly conservative than the last. This rigid adherence to ancestral ways is seen as both a source of strength and stubbornness by those within and beyond the hold. The current head of Clan Дражкарак is Alrik Ranulfsson, great-great-great-grandson of Kurgaz Дражкарак, the clan’s esteemed founder and first patriarch. Alrik’s steadfast traditionalism often brings him into conflict with the Engineer’s Guild, as he favours tried-and-true methods of warfare. Under his leadership, the clan fields more quarrellers and grudge-throwers than thunderers or flame cannons, placing greater trust in ancient craft and proven steel than in newer innovations.

Clan Ізоргрунг has ruled Карак Ізор since the hold’s founding. Under the steadfast leadership of King Kazran Grimbrow, the clan has ensured Карак Ізор remains one of the wealthiest and most influential strongholds in the western mountains. The clan concerns itself chiefly with the oversight of extensive mining operations to meet ever-growing demands, fostering diplomatic relations with the Human farmers who toil upon their surface lands, and maintaining the western stretches of the Underway to bolster trade with neighbouring holds.

Clan Зантром is a clan that others see as insignificant and should just be absorbed by Карак Ізор, worse still, the clan is accused of being Elgongi, elf-friends. While the clan tries to maintain good relations with the elves, their relations are strained at best. Though they are loath to admit, the elves are somewhat dependent on the metals the dwarfs provide, as the dwarfs are dependent on the trees the elves provide. The clan itself was founded shortly after the hold was established and its descendants have ruled the Карак Каферкамаз ever since.

Out of all the hills and mountains settled by the Dwarfs, the Grey Mountains are by far the poorest in minerals. The ore and gem deposits are also harder to mine because of the unstable bedrock. The Dwarfs who settled here were led by tales of untold riches underneath the earth, and their descendants cling to these tales with usual Dwarfen stubbornness, hoping to find these riches one day. Unfortunately, many years have passed, and more and more younger Dwarfs leave the Grey Mountains to seek their fortune elsewhere, the mood among those who remain is increasingly sombre and dour. The largest hold in the Grey Mountains is Карак Норн, Barren Earth Hold. Populated by displaced clans from several fallen holds such as Mount Silverspear and the watchtowers of Mad Dog Pass. Карак Норн sits on the only sizable deposit of ore and gemstones and is strategically placed with its upper level visible on a plateau high above the forest of Атэль Лорэн. This allows the Dwarfs to monitor the activities of the Wood Elves, albeit from a considerable distance. While the Asrai haven't been a threat for over 4,000 years, and the grudge against the High Elves was officially settled with the taking of the Phoenix Crown at the end of the War of Vengeance, the Dwarfs see no harm in precautions. Карак Норн is the smallest of the main Dwarf holds outside the Worlds Edge Mountains, but it still has strong influence over the surrounding Dwarf settlements. The Grey Mountain Dwarfs enjoy a relatively peaceful co-existence with the Bretonnians to the west and a very uneasy truce with the Wood Elves of Атэль Лорэн. They side with the Empire in times of war with Bretonnia, and have been known to close all major passes in the southern Grey Mountains, including the well-travelled Montdidier Pass that transverses the southern end of the range, near The Vaults. Карак Норн is defended by large Flame Cannons and powerful Bolt Throwers. Although clearly designed with the Wood Elves of Атэль Лорэн in mind, the Dwarf defences are a formidable deterrent to any who might seek to invade their realm.

After the death of King Throndin Stoneheart and all his heirs, the throne of Zhufbar lay vacant until the council found a clan worthy of its leadership. That honor fell to Clan Жуфгром; and their founder, Morgrim Ironforge, has assumed the throne to rule over the surrounding Karaks and drive the urk filth and raki scum from the depths of the realm.
Nestled within the Southern Grey Mountains, Карак Зіфлін was a key chokepoint for the Dwarfs during the War of Vengeance.

With heavy choppas in hand and riding the Hagranyms the Orcs of the Злосныя Сякеры Tribe plunder and raid the Bretonnian and Imperial territories surrounding the Pale Sisters. Feared for their predatory steeds, the Злосныя Сякеры and their leader Gromodrak bring terror and death to the puny humies foolish enough to cross their path.

Нікчэмы-Рубакі Orcs are dreaded by Men and other Greenskins alike for their pronounced tendency to aggressively 'chomp' at their foes, both in and out of combat. Whilst cannibalism is widely accepted in Greenskin society, only Snotlings and Squigs are eaten alive; as such, the Нікчэмы-Рубакі have earned an unsavoury reputation even amongst their own kind. Some scholars speculate that the especially 'feisty' Hagranyms working with the clan might be responsible for this disturbing behaviour.

On the Western side of the Pale Sisters wanders the once mighty Племя Чорных Шонцаў. Hailing originally from the plains of Zharr-Naggrund, led by the Black Ork Zorbak, these boyz migrated half the world to join up with the great Waaagh! that was supposed to destroy Ulthuan. Being late to the party, they ended up finding a scattered horde and found themselves quickly surrounded by the Brettonian humies. After a bloody last stand, the boyz were chased into the Pale Sisters and retreated inside the deep caves. Occasionally coming out of their stinky lairs raiding the lands of nearby Курон and Жызарэ, the Orcs led by Zorbak are sure to make a comeback and return to their former strength.

The Калючыя Аловы have learned much from their former Chaos Dwarfs masters. They already had their cruelty, they also had their proportion to explosive bursts of violence. As Orcs, they didn’t really understand the art of crafting intricate siege engines. All in all, Калючыя Аловы only kept the spiky hats from Chaos Dwarfs. They also innovated through good ol’ Greenskins mentality, putting spikes on their armor, their head, and inside their enemies’ skulls. As far as Orcs go, they are an especially bloody bunch.

Facing a fatal defeat against the Dawi-Zharr the Крывае Вока Tribe kicked out their former leader, Ruglud Bonechewer. After a heavy brawl over who should become the next Вайнабос. A victor appeared; it was Bazglud Daemonstompa. The mad lad had destroyed one of the Daemons sent by the Dawi-Zharr; he had made sure a part of the tribe could escape. Under this new leadership, the tribe restored its numbers and now makes itself ready to make Da Biggest Waaagh!

The Orcs of the Гібельныя Рукі carved their clan into existence after hacking their way through a great stretch of the Ghoul Wood and raising crude camps of hide and timber amidst the rotting trees. Like all Greenskins, they raid and pillage wherever they please, but the taint of nearby Vampiric corruption has left its mark upon this tribe. Many Greenskins of the Гібельныя Рукі suffer from strange visions and waking trances, falling upon their own kin in sudden fits of madness before snapping back to their senses, dazed and bloodied. Despite their constant raids to keep the restless dead at bay, more corpses always rise to hound them from the shadows. The Orcs care little for this, of course, to them, it simply means there’s always another scrap to be had.

The Шмяротныя Драбілы is an Orc tribe north of Карак Норн, and east of Атэль Лорэн. They are famous for the everlasting battle against their surrounding enemies. Waging war against the Wood Elves of Атэль Лорэн, the Dwarfs of Карак Норн, and the Humans of Вісэнлянд. They rule the southern part of the Grey Mountains.

This tribe has seen more changes in leadership than most, for the Asrai are relentless in their assassinations of Greenskin Bosses and Warbosses. Yet the Orcs have proven impossible to eradicate entirely; where one grove is purged of them, another warband soon festers elsewhere. In recent years, the tribe had been kept in check, but since the rise of the new Вайнабос, their movements have become utterly unpredictable. Their leader, Cragskar da Mean, has proven maddeningly elusive to Asrai blades and arrows. This is because the warboss himself never stops moving, always twitching, always flailing, always thrashing. Cragskar leads his boyz in raids that seem completely random, striking without warning and vanishing just as swiftly. Under his deranged command, the tribe’s fortunes have shifted dramatically, their chaos proving far deadlier than any plan.

The Буйныя Чопы Tribe is led by Skulgul Horsesmakka. They occupy the stronghold of Massif Orcal, an ancient Greenskin fortress looming over the Forest of Chalons. The Буйныя Чопы are known for their colossal weapons, which are often used to smash and gut Brettonian horses first before finishing the rider.

The Зялёныя Крагі were a loose group of Orcs that plundered the trade routes along the borders of the Empire and Bretonnia. Since theirs is a fairly small tribe, when the Empire decided to take action, the Greenskins fled to Bretonnia and found a new home at the foot of Massif Orcal, joining the larger clan ruling these mountain peaks.

Morglum Necksnapper is an infamous Black Orc Вайнабос who has led his mob from the desolate east to conquer many Orc and Goblin tribes in the World’s Edge Mountains. Those who fight hard enough (and survive) are allowed to join the Шыяломы Tribe, a still-growing horde that has achieved numerous victories. The Шыяломы Tribe is the most feared of the Black Orc tribes who have undertaken the arduous journey across the Dark Lands into the west.

The Племя Чырвонай Косьці pride themselves in fighting everyone, smashing ‘umies, clobbering twiggies, and stunties alike. The variety of meat and scrap they gather has ensured the tribe’s continued prosperity, and they are never short of enemies to fight. There’s been many attempts at stopping the tribe’s raids, but so far every attack has been repelled by the bulky black orcs that make up the majority of the tribe.

For a longer time, the villagers of Каркасон have been suffering raids carried out by a strange breed of Greenskins — Stronger, quicker, and more tenacious Orcs led by Black Orc Bosses coming down from the Irrana Mountains. As their hides also seem tougher than most Greenskins the Bretonnians have begun calling these monsters “Жалезнае Племя” and the “Iron Orcs”.

Nabrot Gitmuncha led his tribe north from Estalia after most of his boys were wiped out by mercenaries. Nabrot himself was found standing amidst a pile of bronze- and brass-clad corpses, knowing full well the tribe was doomed if they stayed. Gathering the survivors, he led them on a brutal exodus north through the Irrana Mountains, the mercenaries refused to follow, thinking the elements will take care of the remaining tribe. Many Goblins perished along the way, mostly ending up as meals for the Orcs. The tribe raided few desolate villages to keep their bellies full, but hunger gnawed at them all the same. Nabrot had to bash more than a few heads to keep order, and when the beasts of the mountains came for them, he slew the monsters himself, trolls, manticores, even chimerae by some accounts. The tribe feasted well on the flesh of their kills and pressed ever northwards. At last, they descended from the mountains and found a rich hunting ground in the southern lands of Carcassonne. There they remain, a blight upon peasant and knight alike, raiding with the same hunger that once nearly consumed them.

For a long time, the Чэрапаломы have been ruling the Grey Mountains and have been the downfall of many Brettonian and Imperial lords. Their territory stretches from the Dukedom of Парравон to the northern part of Райклянд, overseeing their territory from their dreaded fortress, the Garban’s Hold.

This tribe is made up of survivors from various tribes that escaped destruction at the hands of a Bretonnian crusade, launched to cleanse the Grey Mountains of the Greenskin infestation. Known to the Bretonnians as the Grey Mountain Massacre, the campaign ended in disaster when the crusaders were lured into a cunning trap by a wily warboss and slaughtered to a man. It is said that a river of blood flowed down from the Grey Mountains into the Bretonnian countryside that day, a mark of the crusade’s failure and the rise of the Greypeakz Tribe.

The Крывавыя Дзіды Tribe is a clan of Night Goblins who ambush human and Dwarfen caravans attempting to traverse the east provinces of the Empire near the Worlds Edge Mountains. Such is their wealth, it is said that other goblins, orcs, and even trolls flock to them seeking riches and war.

The Крапаючыя Кінжалы are an offshoot tribe of the Крывавыя Дзіды, borne from a dispute about the length of the stabbing tool. After losing and, surprisingly, surviving a duel against Gnashrak Gloomguzzla over the matter of the better stabbing tool, Borguk Da Stabbiest decided to start his own clan, with a captured human assassin called Black Jack, and daggers.

The Чырвонае Вока Tribe is a tribe of Night Goblins settled on the ancient dwarfen fortress of Karak Ungor. After the goblin occupation, it was renamed Чырвонае Вока Mountain. The greenskins stormed the dwarfen fortress by surprise from an underground route, driving the dwarfs out and taking over the fortress. Orcs were also involved in the assault, but they later abandoned the city, leaving the goblins of the Чырвонае Вока Tribe as sole owners of the hold. Today, Goblins of the Чырвонае Вока continue to be the owner of the place, ending the lives of up to 3 dwarf lords who wished to retake it.

The Night Goblin tribe of the Крывавыя Нікчэмы is part of the larger Чырвонае Вока Tribe, located in the Northern World’s Edge Mountains. Their proximity to the province of Сыльванія has led the Night Goblins of this tribe to develop some unusual rituals, all centred around the use and imbibing of blood.

The Рашкрадальнікі are a goblin tribe that is based somewhere in Wrecker's Point. These goblins mainly roam the coast on their mangy wolves and try to loot whatever they can find. They ride crude and rudimentary wooden boats while avoiding the Imperial navy or the sight of the Eonir at the Tower of Se-Athil.

When the men of the Empire set out their borders deep within the surrounding forests, they were unwittingly beginning the bitter Драквальд War, which rages on to this day. The scattered tribes of Wood Goblins that dwelled in the dark regions of the forest stopped fighting each other to face the common enemy. The men of the Empire had unwittingly come too close to the Wood Goblins' most sacred territories, the land known as the Black Pit or the Valley of Many Eyes. From among these clans, the figure of Snagla Grobspit emerged, who thanks to his Чырвоны Яд clan, destroyed the Imperial armies and razed the village of Glomstadt. Afterwards, the Empire believed it had finished off the Чырвоны Яд tribe, but Snagla survived and there were others who escaped deeper into the forest. Snagla swept through the forests, rallying the fleeing goblins and more to his banner, and drove the humans from the depths of Drakwald. Since then, it has become customary for the Чырвоны Яд tribe to collect the feathers from the helmets of fallen Imperials and bathe them in the blood of their former owners as trophies.

Chaos is the term used by mortals to describe the malign spiritual force of supernatural disorder that afflicts the Known World. It is a potent force composed of pure magic that can unleash physical mutation and spiritual corruption upon sentient beings. In perspective, Chaos is akin to the ocean, a constant, roiling force of emotion-fuelled change, the very opposite of the rigid physical laws that govern the natural world. Like the ocean, its power is one that waxes and wanes over time, but this tide constantly batters and seeks to invade the mortal plane of existence.

Beastmen are a race of savage mutant humanoids that exhibit various bestial-looking traits, such as cloven hooves, muscular human bodies, horned bestial heads, and primitive, evil intelligence. The Beastmen are a violent, war-driven race of savage mutants, seeking only to plague and destroy the civilizations of Men and the rest of the mortal world. They prey on the weak and defenseless, attacking lonely settlements without warning on a rampage of destruction before disappearing into the protective darkness of their dark nature, fleeing terrible retribution that often does not come.
Trolls are massive, dim-witted creatures. Known for their regenerative abilities and fierce aggresion, all but the stupid or suicidal treat these creatures with caution.

The Druchii rely on slavery as the primary economic institution that keeps their dark kingdom of Naggaroth functioning and capable of maintaining itself in a permanent state of war. While the inhabitants of ancient Nagarythe were peerless warriors, they had little knowledge of how to build a self-sufficient civilization. For this reason, Malekith's kingdom depends on attacking other peoples for food or capturing slaves to work for them.
The Empire deserters are honorless who fled their duty and now live as fugitives. They now roam the Empire stealing coin from travelers and ambushing caravans.
The famous Brettonian duo Tristan the Troubadour and Jules the Jester.

Bertrand had no desire to push his claim and become a knight, nor did he wish to join the ranks of the nobility and his followers were thoroughly fed up with paying feudal dues. They liked the idea of keeping everything they grew to themselves. If Bertrand took the vows of chivalry he would also have to forsake his beloved longbow as a dishonourable weapon, and that was something he would never do. Instead, Bertrand and his folk took to wandering through the wilderness regions of Bretonnia, righting wrongs and sticking up for the peasants wherever the need may be. Most often this means fighting against raiders and orcs, but sometimes there is a corrupt Baron or Knight, lacking in honour, who needs to be defeated.

The famous Geg of Wainfleet is the one and only peasant ever to be granted knighthood and to have sup from the Holy Grail. Together with his peasant knights, he roams Bretonnia to rid the land of all evil.

The Colleges of Magic in Альтдорф were founded in 2304 I.C. by the great elven mage Teclis, following the last Great War against Chaos. Since then, it has been the premier educational establishment for wizards in the Empire. Each college and its corresponding Order is led by a patriarch or matriarch, and the Supreme Patriarch oversees all colleges. The position of Supreme Patriarch is currently held by Balthasar Gelt of the Gold Order, for he truly is supreme.

The Empire of Man is known for three things: Faith, Steel, and Gunpowder. As faith is paramount among this phrase, so is the cult of the Empire’s main deity, Sigmar. Originally founded in 73 I.C., it has since largely supplanted the Cult of Ulric as the main religious organisation in the Empire, even holding three votes on the Electoral Council. These three votes are held by the Grand Theogonist and two supporting Archlectors, which gives them much sway in determining the next emperor. The current Grand Theogonist is Volkmar von Hindenstern, more colloquially known by his moniker ‘the Grim’.
Lead by Luka Braganza the Абложнікі Браганзы are a famous band of Dogs of War mercenaries that hails from the Tilean city-state of Miragliano, trained and maintained as heavily armored Crossbowmen.

The Праклятая Кампанія of Richter Kreugar the Damned is an ancient mercenary company of Undead, rumoured to enslave those who fall to their deadly blades to eternal servitude.The battle-cry of Richter Kreugar has long been forgotten by the people of the Old World. The silence of the grave hangs over the Праклятая Кампанія as it traverses the land, marching to war accompanied only by the sound of creaking ancient leather and the scrape of rusted metal.

Леапардавая Кампанія Леапольда is a famous band of Dogs of War mercenaries that has its origins within the great city-state of Luccini. The Leopard Company takes its name from the legendary Leopard of Luccini, which is a badge and mascot of the city. It is said that this Leopard was the guardian of the divine twins Lucan and Luccini, founders of the city.

Voland's Venators are a famous band of Dogs of War mercenaries whose reputation as the best cavalrymen in all of Tilea exceeds that of even veteran knights of the Empire or some say, even Bretonnia itself. These band of renegades, exiles, and disposed sons of nobles and lords are expert cavalrymen, and like everyone in the company, their leader is also a superb horsemen.

The Трапнастрэлы Мірагліяна are a famous band of Dogs of War mercenaries whoses origins hails from the Tilean city-state of Miragliano as their name implies. Although the use of the crossbow as a weapon of war is far from uncommon in Tilea, very few mercenary companies can hope to match the accuracy and precision of these marksmen.

Рэспубліканская Гвардыя Рыка are a famous band of Dogs of War mercenaries hailing from the great Republican city-state of Remas. The Republican Guard was raised in Remas by a rebellious group of merchants during the time of disastrous famines and widespread revolt that preceded the birth of the Republic.

Пустэльныя Псы Аль-Муктара are a famous band of Dogs of War mercenaries that hail from the arid-deserts of great Araby. This band of bandit's and mercenaries are experienced raiders and skirmishers often raiding isolated villages, and caravans, while riding in calvary and wearing light armour or leather to make them agile in their attacks.

Working secretly from the shadows for many years, the disciples of the Культ Зламанага Кола have long sought the downfall of the Imperial Colleges of Magic. Worshippers of Tzeentch, the Chaos God of magic and forbidden lore, the cultists of the Broken Wheel view the practises of the eight Colleges as a betrayal of the art of sorcery, structuring and controlling the Winds of Magic instead of revelling in the chaotic, untamed nature of their dark arts.

The Культ Асьветы is an underground fraternal organization that works for the good of its members and the advancement of their lives and careers. This sect of enormously powerful individuals in both politics and the arts commit heinous acts worshiping the Dark Gods Tzeentch and Slaanesh. The cult works for clear purposes: power, money, and fame. Everyone in the innermost circle is well known to the Imperial public in their normal lives, but it is unknown to the majority of members who the Circle members are. Many members have risen to prominence in the Empire through the machinations of the Cult and those that openly oppose it rarely survive the experience. Within the cult's brotherhood are the aspiring, the famous, and the infamous of both the political world and the artistic world, combining efforts to raise the notoriety of all involved and to continue the legacy of the Cult.

One of the most influential Chaos Cults to worship Nurgle is the Fraternity of the Second Flesh. This secret organisation plots to drown the Empire in a morass of squalor and disease, preparing for the End Times when the entire world will fall to Chaos. The Fraternity consists of a group of aristocrats who secretly convene to worship Nurgle at a hidden temple in the sewers beneath a leper hospice in Альтдорф. The cult believes that when the End Times arrive, the Plague Lord will re-clothe each of them in the flesh of an immortal Plaguebearer in an event they call the Transfiguration.
